svg.title: Experience
svg.desc: 2025 – present: PhD in Computer Science, Université Laval · Québec. Autonomous AI agents for the cyberdefense of industrial cyber-physical systems.; 2025 – present: Course Lecturer & Teaching Assistant, Université Laval · Québec. Taught 2 algorithms courses; TA for IoT Security and Advanced C++ (code review, grading).; 2024: Machine Learning Research Engineer, Knowlepsy · Remote. End-to-end ML pipelines for epilepsy health data: time series, signals, ETL on Azure.; 2023: AI Research Intern, UQAT · Rouyn-Noranda. Optimization algorithms for planning sidewalk snow-removal operations.; 2022: AI Intern, Talan Tunisie · Tunis. Distributed architectures for a metaverse project and motion detection algorithms.
